main_text.head: CAP. XIII.
De Iudæorum sub Antiochi tyrannide pa-tientia.
main_text.p: INter captiuitatem Babylonicam, pa-rùm aut nihil ad præsens proposi-tum, præter insignem Antiochi tyran-nidem, & memoratu dignum, accedis-se legimus. {d}Iosephus lib.12.ca.17Hic itaque Iudæis inter se de principatu digladiantibus, ab vna parte in subsidium vocatus, urbem vnà cum exercitu ingressus, spoliato tem-plo, ablatis vasis sacri ministerij, & inter cætera candelabris aureis, altari au-reo, mensaque Propositionis (quam vocant) ac ne auleis quidem relictis, quæ è cocco ac bysso constabant, eva-cuatis etiam thesauris reconditis (ita ut nihil intactum aut intemeratum relin-queret) coniecit Iudæos in luctum ma-ximum, insuper & quotidiana sacra se-cundum Legis præscriptum celebrare eos vetuit, direptaque tota urbe, habi-tatores partim necavit, partim capti-uos vnà cum liberis & vxoribus ab-duxit;

page.notes: The chapter subtitle is printed in italic with "Antiochi" in roman type. The marginal note reads "lib.12.ca.17" in italic; the abbreviation "lib." is read with some doubt. The left-page edge fragments are the neighbouring page and were left out. The page number is read as "51". No catchword is printed.
